Gender nonconformity itself punished under debauchery provisions (1 month–2 years), same-sex conduct death-penalty ceiling with continued arrests despite moratorium, impunity and no data or support. Outing risks criminal punishment directly.

No criminalisation and prosecutorial guidance treats anti-trans hostility as aggravating, but 2024 cabinet direction bans LGBTQIA+ advocacy/promotion, marriage restricted, no discrimination protection, conservative society, thin and rarely invoked recourse.

Statutory protections and hate-crime law, Pride now police-protected, but enforcement fails: bank denial, commonplace discrimination, 79% wouldn't accept LGBT neighbours, and documented custodial isolation/humiliation of a trans detainee by birth sex.
